theme_rankings.tagline: 🚂 AI의 '밴더빌트' — 실제 업무에 AI 박는 운영자
theme_rankings.why_now: 추론 비용 90% 하락 + 엔터프라이즈 도입 본격. 진짜 텐베거 후보가 여기서 다수.
theme_rankings.risk: 밸류에이션 과열. 매출 성장 30%+ 못 보이면 멀티플 압축.

theme_rankings.why_now: AI가 돌아가려면 전기 필요. 미국 변압기 대기 100주+ → 만드는 회사들 5년치 일감 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 후반 진입 우려는 아직 작지만, 금리 급등 시 인프라주 동반 조정.

theme_rankings.why_now: MSFT·GOOG·META·AMZN 2026 Capex 합계 $400B+. AI 매출 회수 본격화 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 광고·소비 둔화 시 Capex 가이던스 컷 가능. 빅테크 동반 변동성.

theme_rankings.why_now: HBM4·CoWoS·EUV 모두 캐파 부족 지속. 2027까지 수요 가시성 확보된 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 정점 논쟁 + 중국 수출 규제 변동성. 어닝 미스 시 30% 낙폭 흔함.

theme_rankings.why_now: 인지노동 다음은 물리노동. 2027~2030 진정한 텐베거 가능 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 상용화 시점 불확실. 미래 옵션밸류 비중 큼. 변동성 극심.

theme_rankings.why_now: 강한 추세장에서만 사용. 분할매수 + 손절선 명확히 + 자산의 5~10% 이하.
theme_rankings.risk: 장기 보유 ❌. 횡보·하락장에선 음의 복리(volatility decay)로 손실 누적.

top_news.title: Nasdaq 100 Has Worst Week Since 2020 on AI Drama: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Weeks of anxiety around the viability of the artificial-intelligence trade erupted into a full-blown selloff, pushing the S&P 500 to a technical correction while lifting bonds and haven currencies.

top_news.title: J&J Snack Foods CEO on 4Q Results and Consumer Sentiment
top_news.summary: J&J Snack Foods CEO Dan Fachner said the company’s turnaround is on track after a strong year, citing Project Apollo’s more than $25 million in durable savings. A second phase, Apollo 2, is expected to generate another $5 million by 2027 through distribution and manufacturing improvements. Fachner speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: El Salvador Troops Killed in Haiti Blast After Rescue Deployment
top_news.summary: Two Salvadoran soldiers died in Haiti after an explosion struck an area where they were working, weeks after President Nayib Bukele ordered a large deployment to the Caribbean island nation to find missing troops.

top_news.title: ‘Always Remain Liquid’: Richards
top_news.summary: Bruce Richards, managing partner and head of CVC Marathon, joins Scarlet Fu and Tom Keene on “Bloomberg Money.” They discuss Richards’ favorite investing advice he has received throughout his career. Richards warns about irrational markets and also says he’s not a fan of leveraged ETF structures. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Anthropic Slides 8.5% to Shrink IPO Gain as AI Trade Unravels
top_news.summary: Anthropic PBC shares erased a portion of their first-day jump on Friday, testing investors’ faith after the AI lab delivered the biggest initial public offering in history.

top_news.title: Trump Says Huang Should Return to Nvidia After ‘Big Apology’
top_news.summary: President Trump called for Jensen Huang to make a big apology and return as CEO of Nvidia even as the prospect remains highly unlikely.  (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: S&P, Dow Slide Into Correction as Investors Dump Tech
top_news.summary: Chipmakers led a plunge in US stocks on Friday, with the S&P 500 and the Dow Jones Industrial Index closing in correction territory. Carmen Reinicke reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Adjusting for Credit Risk: Masters In Business with David Eichhorn
top_news.summary: Barry speaks with David Eichhorn, CEO and Head of Investment Strategies at NISA Investment Advisors. They discuss his early days as a quant at JPMorgan before returning home to St. Louis to work at NISA. They also discuss the risks and benefits of the private credit market, along with the dangers of private credit going into pension funds and 401Ks. They also discuss liability investment strategies for managing over $483 billion in client assets.  (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Gold Logs Worst Week Since March on Hawkish Fed, AI Selloff
top_news.summary: Gold slid for a fifth day — notching its biggest weekly decline since March — as a hawkish Federal Reserve signaled more interest-rate hikes and a rout in AI stocks spurred selling across metals markets.

top_news.title: Nvidia Plunges as SEC Probe Deepens AI Market Selloff | Closing Bell
top_news.summary: Comprehensive cross-platform coverage of the U.S. market close on Bloomberg Television, Bloomberg Radio, and YouTube with Romaine Bostick, Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec. (Source: Bloomberg)
